content.title: Personalized Anniversary Poster, Our Shared Chapter, Names and Date Print
content.description:
Every shared chapter has a beginning. This personalized anniversary poster pairs your names and a significant date with a classic bookplate border, warm ivory background, bookmark detail and an open-book illustration. The quiet literary composition is designed as a keepsake for a couple’s home.

This listing is for one physical 8×10-inch portrait matte poster. It is unframed; the frame and display props shown in review scenes are not included. It is not a digital download.

Enter each partner’s first name and your chosen date. Names are arranged on separate lines in the order supplied. Please check spelling, accents and date carefully. Submit the date as YYYY-MM-DD (for example, 2021-06-18); alternative display styles require manual confirmation. Your personalized layout will be reviewed manually before fulfillment; we will contact you if clarification is needed. Screen colors may differ from the finished print.

Design process: developed with AI assistance and seller direction.
